\theta_E:E\to E,\quad\theta_R:R\to R,\quad\theta_A:A\to A,\quad\theta_D:D\to D,\quad\theta_I:N_I\to N_I,\quad\theta_V:N_V\to N_V

\operatorname{Eq}^{0}_{\mathcal K}
=\bigcap\{E_0\subseteq N_I^2:
(\forall a\in N_I\ (a,a)\in E_0)
\land(\forall a,b\in N_I\ ((a,b)\in E_0\Rightarrow(b,a)\in E_0))
\land(\forall a,b,c\in N_I\ ((a,b)\in E_0\land(b,c)\in E_0\Rightarrow(a,c)\in E_0))
\land\{(a,b):a\approx b\in\mathcal I\}\subseteq E_0\}.

\operatorname{TEq}^{0}_{\mathcal K,k}(\bar a,\bar b)
\Longleftrightarrow\forall j<k\ (\bar a(j),\bar b(j))\in\operatorname{Eq}^{0}_{\mathcal K}.

\operatorname{MinGapCert}_{\operatorname{ER}}(\mathcal K,r,i,x,m,F)\Longleftrightarrow
\operatorname{Complete}(r,i,x)\in\mathcal I
\land F=\{\{\bar b\in F^0_{\mathcal K,r,i,x}:\operatorname{TEq}^{0}_{\mathcal K,\operatorname{ar}(r)}(\bar a,\bar b)\}:\bar a\in F^0_{\mathcal K,r,i,x}\}
\land |F|<m.

\mathsf{Rule}_{key}
=
\left\{
\bigl(
(e(x),e(y),p_0(x,v_0),p_0(y,v_0),\ldots,p_{k-1}(x,v_{k-1}),p_{k-1}(y,v_{k-1}),\operatorname{Key}(e,(p_0,\ldots,p_{k-1}))),
x\approx y
\bigr)
:
e\in E,\ k\in\mathbb N,\ p:k\to A,\ v:k\to N_V,\ x,y\in N_I,
\ p_i=p(i),\ v_i=v(i)\ (i<k)
\right\}.

\mathsf{Rule}_{cardMax}
=\{(((\operatorname{Card}(r,i,m,n),r(\bar a^0),\ldots,r(\bar a^n))\frown\operatorname{seq}(\varepsilon)),\bot_{\mathcal K}):
r\in R,\ k=\operatorname{ar}(r),\ i<k,\ m,n\in\mathbb N,\ m\le n,
\ \forall q\le n\ (\bar a^q:k\to N_I),
\ \exists x\in N_I\ \forall q\le n\ \bar a^q(i)=x,
\ j,\varepsilon\text{ 满足上述有型且逐对不等条件}\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{part}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{\kappa(i)(x_i)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
r\in R,\operatorname{ar}(r)=k,\kappa:k\to E,i<k,\forall j<k\ (x_j\in N_I),\
r(x_0,\ldots,x_{k-1})\in S,\
\operatorname{Rel}(r,\kappa)\in S\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{attr}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{e(x)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
e\in E,a\in A,d\in D,x\in N_I,v\in N_V,\
a(x,v)\in S,\operatorname{Attr}(e,a,d)\in S\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{key}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{x\approx y\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
e\in E,k\in\mathbb N,p:k\to A,v:k\to N_V,x,y\in N_I,\
\operatorname{Key}(e,(p(0),\ldots,p(k-1)))\in S,\
e(x)\in S,e(y)\in S,\
\forall i<k\ (p(i)(x,v(i))\in S\wedge p(i)(y,v(i))\in S)\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{eqTrans}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{x\approx z\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\ x,y,z\in N_I,\
x\approx y\in S,\ y\approx z\in S\}.

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{eqE}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{e(y)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
e\in E,x,y\in N_I,x\approx y\in S,e(x)\in S\}
\cup
\{(S,S\cup\{e(x)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
e\in E,x,y\in N_I,x\approx y\in S,e(y)\in S\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{eqA}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{a(y,v)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
a\in A,x,y\in N_I,v\in N_V,x\approx y\in S,a(x,v)\in S\}
\cup
\{(S,S\cup\{a(x,v)\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
a\in A,x,y\in N_I,v\in N_V,x\approx y\in S,a(y,v)\in S\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{eqR}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{r(x_0,\ldots,y,\ldots,x_{k-1})\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
r\in R,\operatorname{ar}(r)=k,i<k,x_0,\ldots,x_{k-1},y\in N_I,\
x_i\approx y\in S,r(x_0,\ldots,x_i,\ldots,x_{k-1})\in S\}
\cup
\{(S,S\cup\{r(x_0,\ldots,x_i,\ldots,x_{k-1})\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
r\in R,\operatorname{ar}(r)=k,i<k,x_0,\ldots,x_{k-1},y\in N_I,\
x_i\approx y\in S,r(x_0,\ldots,y,\ldots,x_{k-1})\in S\},

\operatorname{Step}^{ER}_{clash}
=
\{(S,S\cup\{\bot_{\mathcal K}\}):S\in\mathsf{MatState}_{\operatorname{ER}},\
x,y\in N_I,x\approx y\in S,x\not\approx y\in S\}.
